changed_disk: the file changed on disk since it was opened
changed_host: the file changed on the host since it was opened
chunk_out_of_order: chunk out of order (expected {expected}, received {got}); upload the file again
copy_into_self: cannot copy a folder into itself
deleted_since_open: the file was deleted since it was opened
dir_exists: a folder with this name already exists: {path}
disabled: File manager disabled (requires the web terminal enabled — start.sh — and NETOPS_UI_FILES other than 0).
move_into_self: cannot move a folder into itself
no_sftp: this host does not offer SFTP ({error})
project_not_found: project not found (or its folder no longer exists)
project_root_protected: the project folder cannot be deleted, renamed or moved
protected_system: {path} is protected: NetOps does not delete, move or rename the root or system folders
root_session_closed: root session ended (5 min idle or closed) — click "Open as root" again
sftp_session_closed: SFTP session ended (the host terminal was closed) — reopen the terminal
ticket_expired: download link expired or already used
too_big_editor: file too large for the editor — download it
too_big_editor_size: file too large for the editor ({size} bytes; limit {limit}) — download it
